title: VTC Member Onboarding
summary: Admit a member to a Verifiable Trust Community: application, decision, and the reciprocal membership credential that closes the bidirectional edge.

applicant.description: The prospective member. Becomes `member` on approval; the same VID throughout, which is why there is no separate member role.

community.description: The community maintainer. Receives the application, relays the reciprocal-credential request, and records the outcome.

administrator.description: An operator of the community, acting on its behalf. A distinct role from `community` because the operator surface and the wire message are different interfaces between different party pairs — see vtc/members/solicit-vmc.

discover.description: Fetch the community's join criteria. Optional and prev-less: an applicant that already knows the criteria skips it, and the enactment is still complete without it.

apply.description: Submit the application with a presentation satisfying the join policy. Opens the enactment: its issuedAt starts the maxDuration clock.

acknowledge.description: Acknowledge receipt and hand back the requestId. Depends only on `apply`, and never rejoins `decide` — the two are concurrent.

supplement.description:
Poll the request. Where the community defers, the applicant supplies further evidence and polls again — bounded repetition, discriminated by ceremony.round.

NOTE: the registry currently defines no task by which the applicant SUPPLIES that evidence (submit takes no requestId, and there is no join-requests/supplement), so `deferred` is a reachable state with no defined exit. This step models the poll only. See docs/design-notes/trust-ceremonies.md §13.5.

decide.description: Approve or reject. Terminal on rejection — a refused applicant produces a complete, verifiable enactment that ends here.

solicit.description: Operator-facing half of the reciprocal exchange: ask the community to request a membership credential from the new member.

ask.description: The wire message that actually reaches the member. A different party pair from `solicit`, which is why they are separate tasks and separate steps.

reciprocate.description: The member delivers the reciprocal credential, closing the bidirectional membership edge. Carries requestId, which is what makes this the join-closing instance rather than an unsolicited renewal delivery — the same Type URI serves both, and only the step name distinguishes them.

sideEffects.rationale: Creates a pending request, admits or refuses a member, and stores a reciprocal credential. Reversible via vtc/members/admin-remove; no step is destructive.

exposure.rationale: max() over the steps is metadata (submit-receipt, status and request-vmc each disclose metadata) and actsAsSubject is true (the applicant submits and later issues a credential on their own behalf). The declared aggregate is not raised above the floor: every step addresses the applicant or the community, so there is no third audience for correlation across steps to disclose anything to.
